# ramble_organization (Resource)

An organisation in a Ramble registry. Packs and jobs can be published under its name.

The user who owns the API token becomes the first owner of a new organisation. Other members are managed with `ramble_organization_member`.

An organisation can be deleted only when it has no packs or jobs. Set `namespace` of each `ramble_resource` to `ramble_organization.<name>.name` so that Terraform destroys the resources first.

The number of members is not an attribute of this resource, because it changes whenever a member is added; the `ramble_organization` data source reports it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The user who owns the API token becomes the first owner.
resource "ramble_organization" "platform" {
  name        = "platform-team"
  description = "Packs and jobs of the platform team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the organisation: 1-64 characters of letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, starting with a letter or digit. Some names are reserved, and a name cannot be the same as a username. Changing it replaces the resource; a change of letter case only does not, because Ramble compares names case-insensitively.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description. Empty by default.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) The name of the organisation as Ramble stores it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the name of the organisation.
terraform import ramble_organization.platform platform-team
```
